name: 正解と意味の案内
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: ONE Lighthouse catalog component LH05-0004 正解と意味の案内, a correct-answer feedback panel.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: Image1 ORIGINAL controls icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, fine control anatomy, alignment and spacing. Image2 rough Japanese mock is SECONDARY for existing Japanese content and compact bounds. Restore the original circular checkmark badge omitted from the mock. Image3 owner-approved style reference controls white surfaces and smooth forest-green primary action, never copy bus content.
Render one compact feedback card at390x205 logical px, proportionally enlarged. Pure-white outer canvas and white card; subtle neutral outline, rounded corners and minimal downward shadow. Remove the original broad lime background and mock broad mint fill. A small forest-green circular success badge with original white check anatomy sits next to the heading. Match original check glyph with rounded consistent stroke, no malformed substitute.
Exact Japanese copy:
“正解です！”
“意味”
“パン屋さんへ行きます。”
“パンを二つ買いませんか？”
Primary button: “次へ進む”
Keep those existing mock lines, punctuation and values verbatim. Do not add a name or a second/third numerical option from original English; any source/translation discrepancy is documented outside the image.
Typography locked Meiryo Bold20/28 heading; Regular12/16 意味 metadata; Regular14/24 body and button; zero tracking. Heading forest#1F6444, supporting copy#6E6E6E, body ink#1D1D1D, button white text. Preserve two body lines and compact spacing.
Layout: header aroundx16y12 with badge before title; metadata aroundy52; bodyy76 andy100; full-width primary buttonx16y145,width358,height44 with12px corners. Retain original subtle bottom edge anatomy and controlled depth.
Accent decision: Original green indicates actual correct-answer completion. Retain semantic green on small check badge/heading and primary continue action, using gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E on the button with gentle rim light. Keep the rest white. No random icon colors, broad mint, neon, heavy gloss or additional ornament.
No quiz choices, progress bar, phone status bar, source branding, title outside card, extra buttons, metrics or watermark. Exactly one success badge and one primary action. All product text remains Japanese.
reviewNotes: Original detail authority restores missing check badge. Output has correct Japanese lines and primary forest gradient, white surfaces. Metadata and button weights too bold versus locked Regular; badge too bright. Needs targeted typography/color correction. Existing source translation discrepancy documented. No owner approval, native editability or runtime claim.
